name: Exp_CandlesticksBW
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom CandlesticksBW indicator, opening buy positions when bullish candlestick patterns are detected and sell positions when bearish patterns are confirmed. It uses a dual-buffer signal system (buffer 4) with threshold comparisons to generate entry and exit signals, and employs fixed Stop Loss/Take Profit levels with configurable money management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义CandlesticksBW指标的信号进行交易，在检测到看涨K线形态时开多仓，在确认看跌形态时开空仓。它使用双缓冲区信号系统（第4缓冲区）通过阈值比较生成入场和出场信号，并采用固定止损/止盈水平及可配置的资金管理方式。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于CandlesticksBW指标识别的K线形态信号进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的前一个值小于2且当前值大于1时开多仓；当指标缓冲区4的前一个值大于3且当前值小于4时开空仓。出场条件为：开多仓信号同时触发空仓平仓，开空仓信号同时触发多仓平仓，形成简单的反向平仓逻辑。仓位管理通过MM参数控制交易手数比例，MMMode参数选择手数计算模式（固定手数或基于保证金的比例计算）。资金管理方面，使用固定的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）设置，盈亏比为2:1，但没有根据市场波动性动态调整止损止盈的机制。策略默认在H4周期运行，使用SMA作为指标的计算方法，信号延迟为1根K线。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on candlestick pattern signals identified by the CandlesticksBW indicator for directional trading. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when indicator buffer 4's previous value is less than 2 and current value exceeds 1; a sell position opens when the previous value exceeds 3 and current value is less than 4. Exit conditions: a buy signal simultaneously triggers closing of sell positions, and a sell signal simultaneously triggers closing of buy positions, implementing a simple reversal-based exit logic. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which sets the trading lot ratio, with MMMode selecting between fixed lot size or margin-based proportional calculation. Money management uses fixed Stop Loss (1000 points) and Take Profit (2000 points) with a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio, but lacks dynamic adjustment based on market volatility. The strategy defaults to H4 timeframe using SMA as the indicator's calculation method with a 1-bar signal delay.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制交易手数大小

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式：固定手数或基于保证金比例
parameters.description_en: Margin mode: free margin/balance/drawdown free margin/drawdown balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow buy position close on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow sell position close on reverse signal

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号K线索引（0为当前K线，1为已完成K线）

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简洁，基于K线形态信号进行交易，易于理解和维护
提供完整的开关控制，可独立控制多空方向的开仓和平仓操作
使用2:1的盈亏比，符合正向期望交易的基本要求
有新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线内重复交易
使用SignalBar=1参数，确保在K线收盘确认后才产生信号，减少虚假信号
pros_en: Clear and concise strategy logic based on candlestick pattern signals, easy to understand and maintain
Provides complete toggle controls allowing independent management of buy/sell open and close operations
Uses a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio, meeting basic positive-expectancy trading requirements
Includes new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trades within the same bar
SignalBar=1 parameter ensures signals are generated only after bar close confirmation, reducing false signals
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点为固定值，未根据市场波动性（如ATR）动态调整，在不同市场条件下可能不适配
缺少点差过滤机制，在点差较大时仍可能开仓，增加交易成本
依赖自定义指标CandlesticksBW，其内部逻辑不可见，策略透明度不足
没有最大持仓数量限制或最大回撤控制，存在持续亏损的风险
信号逻辑使用硬编码的阈值比较（2和3），缺乏自适应优化机制
cons_en: Fixed SL of 1000 points and TP of 2000 points without ATR-based dynamic adjustment may not suit varying market conditions
Lacks spread filter mechanism, may open positions during high-spread conditions increasing trading costs
Depends on the custom CandlesticksBW indicator whose internal logic is not visible, reducing strategy transparency
No maximum position count or maximum drawdown control, creating risk of sustained losses
Signal logic uses hardcoded threshold comparisons (2 and 3) without adaptive optimization mechanism
improvements: 将固定止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态止损止盈，使风险控制适应不同市场波动性
增加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，提高风险管理的完善性
improvements_en: Replace fixed SL/TP with ATR-based dynamic SL/TP to adapt risk control to varying market volatility
Add spread filter and maximum position count limits to improve overall risk management

risk_points: 固定止损止盈不适应市场波动性变化，在高波动市场可能被轻易扫损
缺少最大回撤控制和持仓数量限制，连续亏损时无保护机制
依赖不可见逻辑的自定义指标，策略可验证性不足
risk_points_en: Fixed SL/TP does not adapt to market volatility changes, may be easily stopped out in high-volatility markets
Lacks maximum drawdown control and position count limits, no protection during consecutive losses
Depends on custom indicator with invisible logic, reducing strategy verifiability
